supplements.title: Novel anti-rheumatic potential of Eucalrobusone C: inhibition of rheumatoid arthritis fibroblast-like synoviocytes and metabolic reprogramming.
supplements.summary: Eucalrobusone C, a natural compound from eucalyptus, reduces rheumatoid arthritis cell growth and inflammation through metabolic pathway changes.

supplements.title: Protective effects of zingerone on the retina in diabetic rats.
supplements.summary: Zingerone, a compound from ginger, protected retinal tissue from damage in diabetic rats.

supplements.title: Flavonoid components, antibacterial and anti‑inflammatory activities of extracts from different organs of Sapindus mukorossi Gaertn.
supplements.summary: Sapindus mukorossi plant extracts show strong antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, with potential medical applications.

supplements.title: 19-Hydroxybufalin Inhibits Gastric Cancer Cell Proliferation by Modulating Metabolic Reprogramming.
supplements.summary: A natural compound called 19-hydroxybufalin stops gastric cancer cells from growing by changing how they use energy.

supplements.title: Thymoquinone regulates osteosarcoma cell proliferation through the P53 signaling pathway: A network pharmacology and molecular docking based health technology study.
supplements.summary: Thymoquinone reduces osteosarcoma cell growth by triggering cell death through the P53 signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Free and bound phenolic extracts of Schinus terebinthifolius leaves: phytochemical profiling and in vitro-in silico bioactivity investigations.
supplements.summary: Brazilian pepper leaf extracts showed potent anti-cancer activity against multiple cancer cell lines, along with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.

supplements.title: Anti-Breast Cancer Effects of Carbon Quantum Dots: In Vivo Angiogenesis and Arginase Co-Inhibition.
supplements.summary: Carbon quantum dots inhibit arginase in breast cancer cells, boosting immune response and achieving 68% tumor remission without typical drug side effects.

supplements.title: Topical honey as adjunctive therapy to standard dressing in deep neck abscess: a single-blind randomized controlled trial.
supplements.summary: Honey applied topically alongside standard dressings improved wound healing in deep neck abscess patients, reducing treatment burden.

supplements.title: The Effect of Chromium Picolinate Supplementation on Cardiometabolic Biomarkers, Tumor Necrosis Factor-α Gene Expression, and DNA Damage in Subjects with Metabolic Syndrome: a Randomized Placebo-Controlled Clinical Trial.
supplements.summary: Chromium picolinate supplementation safely improved blood sugar control, cholesterol, and blood pressure in metabolic syndrome patients over 12 weeks.

supplements.title: Cardiometabolic vulnerability in cardio-oncology: mechanistic links, clinical implications, and emerging preventive strategies.
supplements.summary: Cancer patients with existing heart disease risk factors face higher cardiovascular damage from cancer treatments; new preventive strategies help reduce this risk.

supplements.title: Bifidobacterium breve inhibits colorectal cancer via extracellular vesicles containing formate acetyltransferase.
supplements.summary: A probiotic bacterium's extracellular vesicles inhibit colorectal cancer growth through a protein called formate acetyltransferase.

supplements.title: SIRT3 deacetylates STEAP4 to modulate cuproptosis sensitivity via mitochondrial metabolic reprogramming in HBV-related HCC.
supplements.summary: HBV-related liver cancer evades copper-induced cell death through a protein pathway; restoring this pathway with drugs resensitizes tumors to copper treatment.

supplements.title: Glucosamine as a regulator of O-GlcNAc signaling: linking metabolism to disease pathogenesis.
supplements.summary: Glucosamine supplements may influence cancer through metabolic pathways that modify proteins, linking joint health supplements to disease processes.

supplements.title: Anti-cancer mechanism of traditional Chinese medicine natural products targeting ferroptosis.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese medicine natural products kill cancer cells by triggering ferroptosis, an iron-dependent cell death mechanism.

supplements.title: Epigallocatechin-3-Gallate Suppresses Glioma by Targeting Integrin αvβ3/FAK/ERK Signaling Axis and Matrix Metalloproteinases.
supplements.summary: Green tea compound EGCG suppresses glioma growth by blocking signaling pathways and works better combined with standard chemotherapy.

off_label.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and AMPK crosstalk in diabetes mellitus: mechanistic insights and therapeutic applications.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors treat diabetes by activating AMPK, a protein that protects heart, kidney, and liver function through multiple cellular mechanisms.

off_label.title: Cardiometabolic vulnerability in cardio-oncology: mechanistic links, clinical implications, and emerging preventive strategies.
off_label.summary: Cancer patients with existing heart disease risk factors face higher cardiovascular damage from cancer treatments; new preventive strategies help reduce this risk.

off_label.title: AURKA-mediated destabilization of SAPS3 drives ferroptosis evasion via 7-dehydrocholesterol biosynthesis in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: AURKA protein drives colorectal cancer resistance to ferroptosis by altering cholesterol metabolism, making AURKA inhibition a potential treatment strategy.

off_label.title: Pilot Study of Meclofenamate in Subjects With Recurrent or Progressive Brain Metastasis From Solid Tumor Primary
off_label.summary: Researchers test meclofenamate, a pain medication, to stop brain cancer spread in patients with recurring tumors.

off_label.title: Metformin Blunts Vascular Insulin Sensitivity After Exercise Training in Adults at Risk for Metabolic Syndrome.
off_label.summary: Metformin may reduce the vascular health benefits normally gained from exercise training in people at metabolic risk.

off_label.title: A GCLC Inhibitor Enhances the Antitumor Efficacy of Glutathione Metabolic Pathway Inhibition in SMARCB1-Deficient Rhabdoid Tumors.
off_label.summary: GCLC inhibitors effectively kill SMARCB1-deficient rhabdoid tumors by depleting protective glutathione, and work better combined with other metabolic drugs.

off_label.title: LCN2 aggravates sepsis-induced ALI by inhibiting MUC1 to activate ER-stress-autophagy induced ferroptosis via lactate/MCT1/AMPK/mTOR axis.
off_label.summary: LCN2 protein worsens sepsis-induced lung injury through a specific cellular pathway; sorafenib drug shows promise as treatment.

off_label.title: Effect of orlistat and anti-androgen oral contraceptives on pregnancy outcomes in overweight or obese PCOS patients during comprehensive management.
off_label.summary: Overweight women with PCOS who received oral contraceptives and orlistat during preconception care showed improved pregnancy outcomes and live birth rates.

off_label.title: Glycohypoxia: a hypothesis linking chronic hyperglycemia to functional hypoxia and diabetic complications in type 2 diabetes.
off_label.summary: High blood sugar in type 2 diabetes reduces oxygen delivery to cells, causing complications; targeting this oxygen deficit offers new treatment approaches.

off_label.title: Chemoprevention of hepatocellular carcinoma by next-generation antipsychotic aripiprazole.
off_label.summary: Aripiprazole, an antipsychotic drug, prevents hepatocellular carcinoma development by reducing liver inflammation and fibrosis in preclinical models.

off_label.title: Drug repurposing in oncology: Bridging computational discovery to clinical application.
off_label.summary: Drug repurposing uses existing medications to fight cancer faster and cheaper than developing new drugs from scratch.

off_label.title: INSIG1/2 succination mediated by the moonlighting function of ADSL promotes lipogenesis and liver tumorigenesis.
off_label.summary: Glucose activates a protein pathway in liver cancer that boosts fat production and tumor growth; an HIV drug blocks this pathway and improves treatment.

off_label.title: A Feasibility Study of the Repurposing of Prazosin to Improve Treatment Outcomes in Men Receiving Radiotherapy for Prostate Cancer (MiniRaP-00).
off_label.summary: Researchers tested whether an existing blood pressure drug called prazosin could improve outcomes in men receiving radiation therapy for prostate cancer.

off_label.title: Repositioning of Nonsedating Antihistamine Ebastine for Anti-lung Adenocarcinoma Based on EGFR/ERBB2 Dual-targeting Strategy.
off_label.summary: Ebastine, an existing antihistamine drug, effectively kills lung adenocarcinoma cells by targeting two proteins and boosting immune response.

off_label.title: Pharmacokinetic Insights and Therapeutic Potential of Calcium Channel Blockers in Cardiovascular and Non-Cardiovascular Disorders.
off_label.summary: Calcium channel blockers show promise in cancer treatment, particularly T-type variants, with nanocarriers improving their effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Platelets induce VISTA expression and modulate the ovarian tumor microenvironment.
biomarkers.summary: Platelets increase VISTA expression in ovarian cancer, suppressing immune responses and worsening outcomes—a potential new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Novel anti-rheumatic potential of Eucalrobusone C: inhibition of rheumatoid arthritis fibroblast-like synoviocytes and metabolic reprogramming.
biomarkers.summary: Eucalrobusone C, a natural compound from eucalyptus, reduces rheumatoid arthritis cell growth and inflammation through metabolic pathway changes.

biomarkers.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and AMPK crosstalk in diabetes mellitus: mechanistic insights and therapeutic applications.
biomarkers.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors treat diabetes by activating AMPK, a protein that protects heart, kidney, and liver function through multiple cellular mechanisms.

biomarkers.title: Clinical Manifestations of Primary CNS T-Cell Lymphoma: A Retrospective Study of Histopathologic, Molecular, and Neuroimaging Features.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified key diagnostic features of rare brain T-cell lymphoma to help doctors recognize and treat the disease faster.

biomarkers.title: Contribution of Life-Course Socioeconomic Position to Later-Life Brain Volumes in US Hispanic/Latino Adults.
biomarkers.summary: Lifelong low income is associated with smaller brain volumes in older Hispanic/Latino adults.

biomarkers.title: METTL3/IGF2BP2 mediates m6A methylation modification of SNRPA1 to promote tumor property of non-small cell lung cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Two proteins (METTL3 and IGF2BP2) chemically modify SNRPA1 to promote lung cancer cell growth, suggesting a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Microglial fructose metabolism is essential for glioblastoma growth.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking fructose metabolism in brain immune cells slows glioblastoma growth by enhancing the body's anti-tumor immune response.

biomarkers.title: Phosphorylation and DNA damage resolution coordinate SOX2-mediated reprogramming in vivo.
biomarkers.summary: SOX2 protein phosphorylation and DNA repair pathways are essential for reprogramming brain glial cells into neurons in adults.

biomarkers.title: Synthetic SIGLEC9-based chimeric switch receptor augments the efficacy of CAR macrophages against glioblastoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers engineered immune cells called macrophages to fight glioblastoma by reprogramming them to resist tumor suppression and maintain cancer-killing ability.

biomarkers.title: Lethal toxin-equipped effector cells for the potential treatment of cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers engineered immune cells resistant to bacterial toxins, enabling them to safely deliver these toxins directly to cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: TUSCAN: Tumor segmentation and classification analysis in spatial transcriptomics.
biomarkers.summary: TUSCAN uses spatial gene and imaging data to accurately identify tumor regions by detecting copy number variations, improving cancer detection in tissue samples.

biomarkers.title: Rectal Cancer Radiotherapy Response Prediction: Retrospective Study of Development of a Deep Learning-Based Radiomics Model.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed an artificial intelligence model using MRI scans to predict which rectal cancer patients will respond well to radiotherapy before treatment begins.

biomarkers.title: Economic Evaluation of GARDE: A Digital Health Platform for Population-Level Hereditary Cancer Risk Assessment.
biomarkers.summary: GARDE is a digital tool that helps identify undiagnosed hereditary cancer cases and could reduce healthcare costs for institutions.

biomarkers.title: Molecular and Pharmacogenetic Marker Evaluation in Relation to the Toxicity and Clinical Response of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Treatment in Indian Children (MPGx-INDALL): Protocol for a Prospective Observational Cohort Study.
biomarkers.summary: Study evaluates genetic markers to predict treatment response and side effects in Indian children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

biomarkers.title: Venetoclax Retreatment in Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia is biologically rational and clinically effective.
biomarkers.summary: Venetoclax retreatment effectively controls chronic lymphocytic leukemia, with response rates of 72-100% and progression-free survival of 23-58 months.

trials.summary: Researchers identified key diagnostic features of rare brain T-cell lymphoma to help doctors recognize and treat the disease faster.

trials.title: Capturing and tracking clonal T cell response to cancer neoantigens.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a method to track immune T cells targeting melanoma tumors, revealing that CTLA4 immunotherapy boosts tumor-fighting T cell expansion.

trials.title: Bispecific single-domain antibody (VHH) fused with human IgG1 Fc with dual specificity effectively neutralize Naja Kaouthia venom.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a bispecific antibody that neutralizes cobra venom more effectively than traditional horse-derived antivenoms, offering a safer alternative treatment.

trials.title: Engineered romidepsin biosynthetic pathways in Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 improve the efficacy of bacteria-mediated cancer therapy.
trials.summary: Engineered bacteria produce an anticancer drug directly in tumors, improving treatment effectiveness while reducing harmful side effects in mice.

trials.title: Circulating gut microbial metabolites and risk of coronary heart disease: A prospective multi-stage metabolomics study.
trials.summary: Gut bacteria metabolites in the blood may influence coronary heart disease risk, according to this metabolomics study.

trials.title: Lamotrigine-induced Stevens-Johnson syndrome: a systematic review of case reports and case series.
trials.summary: Lamotrigine, used for epilepsy and bipolar disorder, can rarely cause Stevens-Johnson syndrome, a severe skin reaction requiring careful monitoring.

trials.title: Patient-derived outcome assessment of knowledge, communication, and management in those diagnosed with BAP1-tumor predisposition syndrome.
trials.summary: Most BAP1-TPDS patients demonstrated good knowledge of their cancer syndrome, communicated their diagnosis to family, and followed recommended surveillance guidelines.

trials.title: Recommendations for the development of an integrated lung cancer care process: an expert consensus report.
trials.summary: Experts recommend better coordination across lung cancer diagnosis and treatment to improve care quality and equal access for all patients.
